group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the invariant lifecycle in manual order. Initialize with first=q, l1=nil, l2=l and unfold the empty segment. Preserve it by choosing the left disjunct, extending l1_2 with tmp_list, constructing the one-node segment tmp_list-to-q, composing segments, and using the existing list-length resource bound to show unsigned_last_nbits(length+1,32)=Zlength(l1_2)+1. At exit, use tmp_list=0 and xizi_sll_zero to derive l2=nil, convert xizi_sllseg first 0 l1 to xizi_sll first l1, and rebuild xizi_sll_head while closing the length equality.

group_entry.grouping_reason: All three witnesses are the initialization, one-step preservation, and exit stages of the same SingleLinkListGetLen invariant. They use one coherent xizi_sll/xizi_sllseg proof family, share no inter-group dependency, total only three witnesses (below the limit 12), and can be handled sequentially by one worker with less context duplication than separate groups.
group_entry.proof_strategy: Prove the invariant lifecycle in manual order. Initialize with first=q, l1=nil, l2=l and unfold the empty segment. Preserve it by choosing the left disjunct, extending l1_2 with tmp_list, constructing the one-node segment tmp_list-to-q, composing segments, and using the existing list-length resource bound to show unsigned_last_nbits(length+1,32)=Zlength(l1_2)+1. At exit, use tmp_list=0 and xizi_sll_zero to derive l2=nil, convert xizi_sllseg first 0 l1 to xizi_sll first l1, and rebuild xizi_sll_head while closing the length equality.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_pattern: Maintain the decomposition l = l1 ++ l2 while moving exactly one non-null node from the suffix to the prefix; at termination the suffix is empty, so the prefix is the whole list.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_entail_wit.witness_instantiation: Choose the left disjunct with first=q, l1=nil, and l2=l.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_entail_wit.space_plan: Preserve the node_next cell and xizi_sll q l; unfold xizi_sllseg q q nil to emp and cancel the unchanged resources.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_entail_wit.pure_plan: Use PreH1 for linklist_pre<>0, app nil l=l, and Zlength nil=0.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_entail_wit.witness_instantiation: Choose the left disjunct with first=first_2, l1=l1_2 ++ [tmp_list], and l2=l0.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_entail_wit.space_plan: Use xizi_sllseg_len1 on the tmp_list node cell and PreH2, then compose it with xizi_sllseg first_2 tmp_list l1_2 via xizi_sllseg_sllseg; frame the head node_next cell and xizi_sll q l0.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_entail_wit.pure_plan: Rewrite l2_2, l, and length using PreH1/PreH3/PreH4. Apply xizi_sll_loop_length_max with PreH2 to bound Zlength(l1_2 ++ tmp_list :: l0). From Zlength_nonneg and Int.max_unsigned=4294967295 derive 0<=Zlength l1_2+1<2^32, rewrite unsigned_last_nbits_eq, use Zlength_app_cons, and close list associativity.

proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_return_wit.witness_instantiation: Choose the first disjunct, which retains the head node_next resource and targets xizi_sll_head linklist_pre l.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_return_wit.space_plan: Substitute tmp_list=0; apply xizi_sll_zero to xizi_sll 0 l2 to obtain l2=nil; apply xizi_sllseg_0_sll to obtain xizi_sll first l1; unfold the head predicate and combine it with the preserved head node_next cell.
proof_of_SingleLinkListGetLen_return_wit.pure_plan: Substitute l=l1++nil and length=Zlength l1, rewrite app_nil_r, and conclude length=Zlength l.
